inverse_edits.prior_text: A **UI SPEC** is a runnable or renderable design reference with representative content, a meaningful reader/user path and identifiable review scope. Establish whether the deliverable is a working product, representative product demonstration or authored visual work; select realization and evidence for that boundary. Documents can complete reading tasks without an application shell. Use the project's framework, format and preview mechanism; one implementation can support fixtures and real adapters. A fixed-stage demonstration does not establish an interactive product.
| Begin or adopt a UI effort | `init` | Accurate project understanding, relevant constraints and a next useful slice |
| Continue, add, refine, consolidate or correct | `iterate` | One meaningful implemented increment, inspected and ready for review |

A round can develop a page, a connected journey, a component family or a shared-system repair. Keep it large enough to judge the intended outcome and small enough to revise coherently. Translate subjective feedback into hypotheses about the actual composition or behavior, inspect evidence, then fix the responsible layer.
